descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load this skill when the task mentions look at, examine, or inspect an object under/with/in a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Take the object, go to the lamp, and turn it on with `use`. Any task with a lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Load for any simple "put a/some X in/on Y" or "move X to Y" task with one object (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet"). Use it when the task has no hot/heat/cool/cold/clean words, no lamp, and no "two". Find, take, put.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Load when the task says "clean", "wash", or "rinse" an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet", "clean some mug and put it on the desk"). Take the object to the sinkbasin, clean it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Load when the task says "cool", "cold", "chill", or "refrigerate" an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table", "cool some mug and put it in the cabinet"). Take the object to the fridge, cool it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Load when the task says "hot", "heat", "warm", or "cook" an object and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat some egg and put it on the table"). Take the object to the microwave, heat it, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task says "two" or asks for 2 of an object (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet"). Find and place the first object, then find and place a second one, carrying one at a time.
